title: Two Hundred Milliseconds
description: Follow a request through eligibility, retrieval, ranking, auction, serving, and logging.
exercise: Trace one request and build an eligibility filter.

title: The Auction
description: Compare first-price and second-price auctions; connect bids and click probabilities to eCPM.
exercise: Build a simplified GSP auction and examine reserves.

title: Predictions Are Prices
description: Separate ranking from calibration and examine how prediction errors affect prices.
exercise: Fit a calibration layer and inspect advertiser slices.

title: Logging: The Memory of the System
description: Design impression and event logs, joins, attribution windows, and feature snapshots.
exercise: Join labels using event time and stable keys.

title: Labels and Bias
description: Study position bias, selection bias, exploration, and inverse propensity weighting.

title: Features
description: Use categorical features, crosses, histories, hashing, and smoothed statistics.

title: How a Model Learns
description: Derive logistic regression, gradients, regularization, and train-validation splits.
exercise: Implement a gradient step and train a baseline.

title: Losses and Model Heads
description: Compare binary cross-entropy, MSE, Poisson, pairwise ranking, and softmax objectives.
exercise: Match the label, head, and loss to the product objective.

title: Evaluation, Offline and Online
description: Interpret AUC, normalized entropy, calibration, slices, and randomized experiments.
exercise: Write a launch recommendation with uncertainty.

title: Retrieval
description: Build independent user and ad towers and understand dot products, negatives, and ANN retrieval.
exercise: Evaluate recall against a declared candidate target.

title: Towers, Crosses, and Transformers
description: Explore embeddings, MLPs, cross layers, target attention, and sequence models.
exercise: Compare architectures under data and latency constraints.

title: Conversion Modeling
description: Handle sparse outcomes, delayed feedback, selection, and shared-task learning.
exercise: Compare naive pCVR and an ESMM-style model.

title: Pre-training, Fine-tuning, and Freshness
description: Distinguish pre-training, fine-tuning, warm starts, distillation, and retraining.
exercise: Design a freshness policy with evaluation gates.

title: Quality Beyond the Click
description: Balance advertiser outcomes, negative feedback, ad load, and long-term user experience.
exercise: Explore a quality penalty and document its assumptions.

title: Run the Marketplace
description: Combine the stack with budgets, pacing, and explicit feedback assumptions.
exercise: Run a simulated quarter and write an evidence-based review.
